messages:
maya: Heads-up — discovered ~45 k8s Secrets in staging containing KMS-wrapped blobs (base64) instead of Vault refs. Looks like secret-syncer v2.1.4 wrote raw wrapped payloads after a retry bug. Need a sweep + rotation + audit enablement. pinging sec/devops :eyes:

jamal: Can you paste a short `kubectl get secrets` sample and the KMS key path?

maya: sample output (redacted):
```
NAME                        TYPE     ANNOTATIONS
svc-db-creds                Opaque   kmsKey=projects/rw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/rw-infer-key
worker-api-token            Opaque   kmsKey=projects/rw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/rw-infer-key
feature-flag-store          Opaque   kmsKey=projects/rw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/legacy-key-v3
```
All of these have `data` values that look like base64(wrapped_blob) rather than `vault:` refs.

olivia: @devops-oncall is this during the canary rollout? any rollback in-flight?

security-bot: automated alert — secret-syncer failure rate spike detected (2026-10-12T14:03:11Z). Incident created: INC-2026-321. Triage channel: #inc-INC-2026-321.

devops-oncall: Confirmed — canary of v2.1.4 failed 2/3 nodes for the sync step. Rolling back to v2.1.2 now. Suspect bug: when syncer hits KMS quota error it retries and writes wrapped payload instead of calling Vault write hook. Will pause rollout and revoke write perms for the syncer SA until patch.

ethan: Proposed immediate plan (high-level):
1) Snapshot affected secrets list and mark them `rotation_pending`.
2) Revoke syncer SA write permission to avoid more bad writes.
3) Rewrap KMS key if we suspect key material exposure, otherwise rotate secret values by re-encrypting through Vault.
4) Schedule an orchestrated rotation window (low traffic) and update apps to re-read secrets.
5) Verify audit logs (Cloud KMS + GKE API + Vault) stored in SIEM for timeline. :lock:

jamal: For (5) — make sure Cloud Audit Logs for KMS Admin/DataAccess are exported to splunk-es/rw-security. If there's any Decrypt calls by unknown identities we must escalate.

maya: For immediate cleanup I sketched a helper flow: snapshot list + annotate + trigger vault-sync. Snippet: 
```
# list affected
kubectl get secrets -n staging -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\n"}{end}' --field-selector metadata.annotations.kmsKey!=""] > /tmp/affected.txt

# annotate to mark for rotation
xargs -a /tmp/affected.txt -I{} kubectl annotate secret {} -n staging redwood/security=rotation_pending

# trigger vault syncer job
kubectl create job vault-syncer-manual-$(date +%s) -n infra --image=ghcr.io/redwood/secret-syncer:v2.1.2 -- /sync --mode=manual
```
(we'll tighten selectors before running)

olivia: I'll open a log-forwarding ticket to ensure KMS DataAccess is in SIEM and add a Splunk search template. Ticket: SEC-4582.

devops-oncall: Rotation window proposal: 02:00 UTC tomorrow (2026-10-13). I'll coordinate with app teams. We should also run a smoke test harness that hits auth flows after rotation.

ethan: Also update RBAC: remove `secretmanager.secrets.update` equivalent from syncer SA and replace with limited `get/list` until we patch. If we revoke write now, ensure there is a fallback path for legitimate syncs.

jamal: Agree. I'll draft an ACL change PR for iam-policy that replaces `roles/secretmanager.admin` with a custom role `roles/redwood.syncer` (get/list) and link to PR in this thread.

maya: Owners: devops-oncall (coord), olivia (logs + SIEM), jamal (RBAC PR), ethan (rotation runbook + smoke tests), maya (cleanup script + affected list). Will post affected secrets list to the incident channel after redaction.

devops-oncall: Quick status — rollback done, syncer write perms revoked, creating rotation job tonight at 02:00 UTC.

olivia: SEC-4582 created and assigned to me. Splunk saved search: `index=cloudkms AND protoPayload.methodName=\"cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt\" AND NOT serviceAccount:syncer-sa@redwood.iam`

security-bot: INC-2026-321 updated — owners assigned and playbook step `secrets_rotation` scheduled.

maya: Thanks all. I'll paste redacted `/tmp/affected.txt` to #inc-INC-2026-321 and kick the annotate step once owners ack. :thumbsup:

ethan: acked. will prepare runbook checklist (pre/post health checks, rollback steps).

jamal: acked, will post RBAC PR in ~30m.

olivia: acked, will confirm SIEM alerts by EOD. :eyes:
